import { useState } from 'react';

export const Button = ({ label, onPress }) => {
	const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
	return (
		<button type="button" onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>
			{label} ({count})
		</button>
	);
};

#include <vector>
#include <string>

template <typename T>
auto sum(const std::vector<T>& xs) -> T {
	T total{};
	for (const auto& x : xs) total += x;
	return total;
}

int main() { return sum<int>({1, 2, 3}) == 6 ? 0 : 1; }

package fixtures

data class User(val name: String, val age: Int = 0)

fun main() {
	val users = listOf(User("Ada", 36), User("Linus"))
	val names = users.filter { it.age > 0 }.map { it.name }
	println("Found ${names.size}: $names")
}

local M = {}

-- Merge two tables, right wins.
function M.merge(a, b)
	local out = {}
	for k, v in pairs(a) do out[k] = v end
	for k, v in pairs(b or {}) do out[k] = v end
	return out
end

return M
